scope: Host-validated weighted-prefix source, three CPU-only CUDA13.3.73 sm120 wrapper compiles and retained code/call accounting. No GPU, executable or full-client execution.
limits: Entry register counts and zero stack/shared/local are compiler resource properties, not measured residency or throughput.
Both candidates remain unvalidated on a GPU; host compilation executed CLMAD software fallbacks.
Complete selected-path instruction visits include all B16 live slots, no DP/guard and helper returns. They exclude launch prologue/exit, reseed/checkpoint/driver work and are not cycles.
The same 85 field products / 510 CLMAD operations per B16 worker-step remain. The pair helper performs two full products.

Mode2 emits 56 actual SASS mask loads for its paired sigma helper, versus two56-load scalar calls per coordinate pair in modes0/1. Logical load bytes are not DRAM bytes, cache misses or runtime traffic measurements.
Fewer registers, helper calls, mask loads or instruction visits do not establish a speedup. Full-client compilation/correctness/runtime binding would be a separate phase.
